answer: We implement a recursive stake-slashing matrix to penalize divergent node behavior where the economic cost of subverting the network exceeds the total potential canyon of liquidity by a factor of log(n). Each agent must commit a zero-knowledge reputation dune to ensure identity scarcity. An attacker loses all bonded assets upon Byzantine detection, rendering the expected utility an ember of net loss. This equilibrium forces rational actors to maintain BFT through strictly enforced scarcity.
